name: SIEM event monitoring
description: PC-3 sends TCP segments with invalid flags (an XMAS probe). IDS-1 and IPS-1 detect them (D6) and the SIEM shows the events.

presentation.objective: Show a controlled security event travelling from the component that produced it into the SIEM and its incident history.
presentation.security_rule: Detector D6 (invalid TCP flags), seen by IDS-1 (passive) and IPS-1 (inline).
presentation.explanation: IDS-1 and IPS-1 each raise a D6 alert from their own view of the traffic; the SIEM receives them from the sensors that produced them, groups them into one incident for PC-3, and keeps it in its history. In Enforce mode IPS-1 also drops the segments; in Monitor mode it only records what it would do.
expected: IDS-1 and IPS-1 each raise a D6 alert
The SIEM lists the events with source, severity, time and reason
Monitor mode forwards the segments; Enforce mode drops them at IPS-1
